Select canonical_smiles from compound_structures, chembl_id from molecule_dictionary, and standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units from activities for assay CHEMBL3705858. Join activities to assays on assay_id, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter to exact measurements only: standard_relation must be '=' and standard_value must not be null. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
